            chk("Liquidity", True, "no volume data for this instrument (index/future proxy): not checked", hard=False)
        cfg_c = {**C.DEFAULTS, **(store.get_setting("costs") or {})}
        spread = setup["entry"] * cfg_c["spread_bps"].get(market, 2.0) / 10000
        chk("Spread", spread <= (setup.get("max_spread") or spread), f"estimated spread {spread:,.4g} vs max {setup.get('max_spread') or 0:,.4g} (model spread; no live depth feed)")
    hard_fail = [c for c in checks if not c["ok"] and c["hard"]]
    verdict = "REJECTED" if hard_fail else ("APPROVED" if mode == "paper" else "OBSERVE")
    return {"verdict": verdict, "checks": checks, "sizing": sz, "failed": [c["check"] for c in hard_fail], "book": {
        k: (round(v, 2) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in bk.items() if k not in ("open", "recent")}}


def _ml_checks(chk, ctx: dict, bud: dict, orisk: float, used_loss: float, sym: str, is_options: bool,
               unlimited: bool = False) -> tuple[float, dict | None]:
    """ML layer (ml.py), ACTIVE mode only. It can add a failing check or halve the risk - never anything else."""
    mlp = ctx.get("ml")
    if not mlp or mlp.get("mode") != "active":
        return 1.0, ({"mode": mlp.get("mode"), "p": mlp.get("p"), "action": mlp.get("action"), "effect": "none (shadow)"} if mlp else None)
    p, a, th = mlp["p"], mlp["action"], mlp.get("thresholds") or {}
    chk("ML filter", a != "skip", f"model #{mlp.get('model_id')}: {p * 100:.0f}% chance of 1:2 before the stop (base rate {mlp.get('base_rate', 0) * 100:.0f}%); "
        f"skip below {th.get('skip_below', 0) * 100:.0f}%, full size from {th.get('full_from', 0) * 100:.0f}% -> {a.upper()}")
    room = bud["part_budget"] - orisk - used_loss
    last = room < 2 * bud["per_trade"] and not unlimited          # unlimited mode: no slot rationing
    chk("ML budget priority", not (last and a != "full"),
        (f"room for one more trade ({room:,.0f}): kept for a FULL-confidence setup, this one is {a}" if last and a != "full" else
         f"room {room:,.0f} = {room / (bud['per_trade'] or 1):.1f} trades: no rationing needed" if not last else "full-confidence setup: may use the last slot"))
    mult = 0.5 if a == "half" else 1.0                   # no lot rule any more: half confidence = half risk for every market
    eff = "half risk" if mult < 1 else "full risk"
    return mult, {"mode": "active", "p": p, "action": a, "effect": eff, "model_id": mlp.get("model_id")}


def _options_checks(chk, op: dict, setup: dict, ctx: dict, cap: float, risk_pct: float, r: dict, now: float,
                    max_capital: float | None = None) -> dict:
    from . import options as OP
    st, pl = op["structure"], op.get("plan")
    idx = OP.is_index(st["underlying"])
    age = now - (st.get("chain_as_of") or 0)
    chk("Option prices fresh", age <= r["opt_max_chain_age_s"], f"chain/quotes {int(age)} s old (max {r['opt_max_chain_age_s']} s)")
    bad = OP.leg_liquidity(st["legs"], r, idx)
    chk("Option leg liquidity", not bad, "; ".join(bad) or f"all {len(st['legs'])} leg(s) two-sided, spreads within {r['opt_max_leg_spread_pct' if idx else 'opt_max_leg_spread_pct_stock']}%, open interest present")
    sells = any(lg["side"] == "SELL" for lg in st["legs"])
    if sells:
        chk("Days to expiry (selling)", st["days"] >= r["opt_min_dte_sell"], f"{st['days']:.1f} days to {st['expiry']} (min {r['opt_min_dte_sell']} for any short leg)")
    if not pl:
        chk("Position size", False, "no executable prices for every leg")
        return {"qty": 0, "why": "no executable prices"}
    budget = cap * risk_pct / 100
    sz = OP.size(st, pl, budget, r, max_capital)
    sz.update(structure=OP.describe(st), kind=st["kind"], v0=pl["v0"], sl_value=pl["sl_value"], tp_value=pl["tp_value"], tp1_value=pl["tp1_value"],
              trail_unit=pl["trail_unit"],
              breakevens=pl["payoff"]["breakevens"])
    chk("Position size", (sz.get("qty") or 0) > 0, sz.get("why") or
        f"{sz['lots']} lots x {sz['lot']} = {sz['qty']} units of {OP.describe(st)}; risking {sz['max_loss']:,.0f} of {sz['budget']:,.0f} INR per-trade risk ({risk_pct:.3g}% of equity)")
    if not sz.get("qty"):
        return sz
    chk("Maximum loss within budget", sz["max_loss"] <= sz["budget"] + 1e-6, f"planned loss at the position stop {sz['max_loss']:,.0f} incl. fees {sz['fees']:,.0f}")
    chk("Structural maximum loss", sz["structural_max_loss"] <= sz["budget"] * r["option_premium_risk_x"] + 1e-6,
        f"worst case at expiry (payoff verified) {sz['structural_max_loss']:,.0f} vs {r['option_premium_risk_x']:g} x budget {sz['budget'] * r['option_premium_risk_x']:,.0f}")
    lens = st.get("lens") or {}
    dr = st.get("direction")
    against = (dr == "LONG" and lens.get("view") == "bearish") or (dr == "SHORT" and lens.get("view") == "bullish")
    chk("Seller's view", not against and (dr != "NEUTRAL" or lens.get("view") == "range"),
        f"writers: {lens.get('view')} ({lens.get('basis')}); " + "; ".join(lens.get("reads") or []))
    chk("1:2 achievable", bool(pl.get("rr_ok")), pl.get("rr_why") or
        f"lot 1 books at value {pl['tp1_value']:,.2f} (1:2 after costs: {sz['rr_net']:.2f}R on lot 1); lot 2 then trails {pl['trail_unit']:,.2f}/unit")
    if st["kind"] in OP.CREDIT:
        cr = pl.get("credit_ratio") or 0
        chk("Credit vs width", cr >= r["opt_min_credit_ratio"], f"credit {-pl['v0']:,.2f} = {cr * 100:.0f}% of the {pl['width']:g}-point width (min {r['opt_min_credit_ratio'] * 100:.0f}%)")
    else:
        u = st.get("und") or {}
        wall, tgt = u.get("wall"), u.get("und_target_1")
        ok = tgt is not None and (wall is None or ((wall > tgt) if dr == "LONG" else (wall < tgt)))
        chk("Room to 1:2 target", ok, f"underlying 1:2 point {tgt:,.0f}; writers' wall {wall if wall is not None else 'none'}"
            if tgt is not None else "no underlying plan")
    chk("Costs vs risk", sz["fees"] <= r["max_cost_share"] * sz["max_loss"], f"fees {sz['fees']:,.0f} = {sz['fees'] / sz['max_loss'] * 100:.0f}% of the planned loss (max {r['max_cost_share'] * 100:.0f}%); spreads already paid by buying at ask / selling at bid")
    chk("Leverage", sz["premium"] <= r["max_notional_x"] * cap, f"premium {sz['premium']:,.0f} = {sz['premium'] / cap:.2f}x equity (max {r['max_notional_x']}x)")
    return sz


def post_trade_limits(now: float | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """After every close: halt the agent when the drawdown limit is breached (stays halted until the user resets)."""
    r = CFG.risk()
    out = []
    for cur in ("INR", "USD"):
        bk = book(cur, now)
        if bk["drawdown_pct"] >= r["max_drawdown_pct"] and not halt_state().get("on"):
            set_halt(True, f"{cur} drawdown {bk['drawdown_pct']:.2f}% >= {r['max_drawdown_pct']}%")
            out.append(f"HALT: {cur} drawdown {bk['drawdown_pct']:.2f}%")
    return out
backend/agent/learning.py:
"""Post-trade intelligence. Every closed agent trade gets a review built ONLY from recorded data: the decision row
(setup, evidence, every Risk Guardian check), the position state (fills, exits, MAE/MFE in R) and the agent's market
observations before and after. Nothing is invented; questions the data cannot answer say so.

Outcome classification (first rule that matches):
  Data-quality failure            the entry was taken on a fallback source or a data-quality warning
  Execution failure               entry filled > 0.25R worse than planned
  Risk-management failure         loss beyond -1.3R (gap / slippage through the stop: the plan's max loss was exceeded)
  Correct strategy, profitable    P&L > 0
  Poor exit                       a loss after the trade had been >= +1R in favour (MFE)
  Poor entry                      a loss with entry slippage > 0.15R, or MAE >= 0.9R before any favourable move of 0.3R
  Incorrect market interpretation a loss that never went 0.25R in favour, or the regime flipped against the trade
  Correct strategy, losing outcome every other loss (it moved the right way, then the stop was hit: normal variance)
A losing trade is therefore NOT automatically a strategy failure.

LLM narrative: optional (agent setting llm_reviews and AI configured in .env). The model receives the review facts as
JSON and is told to use nothing else; its text is stored separately (narrative_source = llm:<provider>) and never
changes the classification or any decision.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from . import db

BULL = ("strong_bull", "weak_bull")
BEAR = ("strong_bear", "weak_bear")


def _regime_side(rg: str | None) -> int:
    return 1 if rg in BULL else -1 if rg in BEAR else 0


def classify(t: dict, st: dict, regime_after: str | None) -> str:
    d = 1 if t["side"] == "LONG" else -1
    risk_u = abs(t["entry"] - t["stop"]) or 1e-9
    slip_r = (st.get("entry_slippage") or 0) / risk_u
    r = t.get("r_result") or 0
    if "fallback" in str(st.get("fill_source", "")).lower() or ((st.get("quality_at_entry") or {}).get("ok") is False):
        return "Data-quality failure"
    if slip_r > 0.25:
        return "Execution failure"
    if r < -1.3:
        return "Risk-management failure"
    if (t.get("pnl") or 0) > 0:
        return "Correct strategy, profitable execution"
    mfe, mae = st.get("mfe_r") or 0, st.get("mae_r") or 0
    if mfe >= 1.0:
        return "Poor exit"
    if slip_r > 0.15 or (mae >= 0.9 and mfe < 0.3):
        return "Poor entry"
    if mfe < 0.25 or _regime_side(regime_after) == -d:
        return "Incorrect market interpretation"
    return "Correct strategy, losing outcome"


def review(trade_id: int) -> dict | None:
    t = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_trades WHERE id=? AND status='closed'", (trade_id,), one=True)
    if not t or db.q("SELECT id FROM agent_reviews WHERE trade_id=?", (trade_id,), one=True):
        return None
    st = db.jload(t["payload"], {})
    dec = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions WHERE id=?", (t["decision_id"],), one=True) or {}
    s = db.jload(dec.get("setup"), {})
    chk = db.jload(dec.get("checks"), {})
    obs_after = db.q("SELECT regime, volatility, bar_time FROM agent_observations WHERE symbol=? AND tf=? AND t<=? ORDER BY bar_time DESC LIMIT 1",
                     (t["symbol"], t["tf"], (t["closed_at"] or 0) + 120), one=True) or {}
    regime_after = obs_after.get("regime")
    cls = classify(t, st, regime_after)
    risk_u = abs(t["entry"] - t["stop"]) or 1e-9
    ev = s.get("evidence") or {}
    hit = st.get("hit") or []
    soft = [c["check"] for c in (chk.get("checks") or []) if not c["ok"] and not c.get("hard")]
    targets = s.get("targets") or json.loads(t["targets"] or "[]")
    win = (t["pnl"] or 0) > 0
    answers = {
        "1_why_initiated": f"{s.get('strategy_name') or t['strategy']} {t['side']} at score {s.get('score')}: " + "; ".join((s.get("reasons_for") or [])[:4])
                           + f". Independent evidence: {', '.join(ev.get('agree') or []) or 'none'}.",
        "2_regime_correct": f"Entry regime {t['regime']}; latest observed regime at exit {regime_after or 'not observed'}"
                            + (" (flipped against the trade)" if _regime_side(regime_after) == -(1 if t['side'] == 'LONG' else -1) else ""),
        "3_entry_optimal": f"Planned {t['planned_entry']:,.4g}, filled {t['entry']:,.4g} ({(st.get('entry_slippage') or 0) / risk_u:+.2f}R slippage); "
                           f"worst excursion before exit {st.get('mae_r', 0):.2f}R",
        "4_stop_appropriate": f"Stop {(s.get('atr') and f'{risk_u / s['atr']:.2f} ATR') or 'n/a'} from entry; "
                              + ("stop hit" if "stop" in (t["exit_reason"] or "") else f"exit by {t['exit_reason']}"),
        "5_target_realistic": f"Targets reached: {', '.join(hit) or 'none'}; best excursion {st.get('mfe_r', 0):.2f}R vs T1 at "
                              f"{abs(targets[0] - t['entry']) / risk_u:.2f}R" if targets else "no targets recorded",
        "6_expected_price": f"Entry slippage {(st.get('entry_slippage') or 0) / risk_u:+.2f}R; total costs {t['costs']:,.2f} {t['currency']}",
        "7_strategy_as_expected": f"Backtest status for this symbol/timeframe: {(s.get('validation') or {}).get('status', 'not backtested')}; "
                                  f"result {t['r_result']:+.2f}R",
        "8_misleading_indicators": ("Families that agreed but did not deliver follow-through: " + ", ".join(ev.get("agree") or [])) if not win and (st.get("mfe_r") or 0) < 0.25
                                   else "No evidence of misleading inputs from the recorded data",
        "9_avoidable": ("Marginal setup: " + ", ".join(soft)) if soft else ("Opposing evidence was present: " + ", ".join(ev.get("oppose") or [])) if ev.get("oppose")
                       else "Not avoidable on the information at entry (all checks passed)",
        "10_improvement": {
            "Correct strategy, profitable execution": "None required; keep sampling.",
            "Correct strategy, losing outcome": "None from one trade: normal variance. Watch the strategy's rolling expectancy.",
            "Incorrect market interpretation": "Check whether this strategy should be filtered harder in this regime (research: regime breakdown).",
            "Poor exit": "Research a different trailing rule (e.g. trail after +1R) for this strategy.",
            "Poor entry": "Research entering on a retest / limit inside the entry zone instead of at market.",
            "Risk-management failure": "Loss exceeded plan: raise gap allowance or avoid holding through known events.",
            "Execution failure": "Slippage too large: tighten the allowed entry drift or avoid fast markets.",
            "Data-quality failure": "Tighten the data-quality gate for this source.",
        }[cls],
    }
    narrative = (f"#{t['id']} {t['symbol']} {t['side']} ({t['strategy']}, {t['regime']}): {cls}. "
                 f"{t['r_result']:+.2f}R, P&L {t['pnl']:,.2f} {t['currency']}, exit {t['exit_reason']}. "
                 f"MFE {st.get('mfe_r', 0):.2f}R / MAE {st.get('mae_r', 0):.2f}R.")
    rid = db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_reviews(trade_id, t, classification, answers, narrative, narrative_source) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                     (trade_id, db.now(), cls, json.dumps(answers), narrative, "deterministic"))
    db.log("review", f"Review #{trade_id}: {cls}", t["symbol"], {"trade_id": trade_id})
    return {"id": rid, "trade_id": trade_id, "classification": cls, "answers": answers, "narrative": narrative}


async def llm_narrative(trade_id: int) -> str | None:
    """Optional plain-language write-up from the configured LLM, grounded in the stored review facts only."""
    import os
    if not (os.getenv("AI_PROVIDER") and os.getenv("AI_API_KEY") and os.getenv("AI_MODEL")):
        return None
    r = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_reviews WHERE trade_id=?", (trade_id,), one=True)
    t = db.q("SELECT symbol, side, strategy, regime, entry, exit, stop, r_result, pnl, currency, exit_reason FROM agent_trades WHERE id=?", (trade_id,), one=True)
    if not r or not t:
        return None
    facts = {"trade": t, "classification": r["classification"], "answers": db.jload(r["answers"], {})}
    prompt = ("You are reviewing a PAPER trade. Use ONLY the JSON facts below; do not add prices, news or reasons that are not in them. "
              "Reply as JSON {\"review\": \"<=120 words\"}.\nFACTS: " + json.dumps(facts, default=str))
    try:
        from backend.app import ai_analysis, AIRequest   # lazy: avoids a circular import at start-up
        res = await ai_analysis(AIRequest(prompt=prompt[:12000]))
        text = res.get("text") or ""
        try:
            text = json.loads(text).get("review", text)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        db.execute("UPDATE agent_reviews SET narrative=?, narrative_source=? WHERE trade_id=?",
                   (r["narrative"] + "\n\nLLM: " + text[:1500], f"llm:{res.get('provider')}", trade_id))
        return text
    except Exception as exc:                              # noqa: BLE001 - optional
        db.log("review", f"LLM narrative unavailable: {str(exc)[:120]}", level="warn")
        return None
backend/agent/options.py:
"""Options desk for the agent: index options (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY, SENSEX, BANKEX) and NSE stock
options. PAPER ONLY. Option BUYING and DEFINED-RISK option SELLING (every short leg has a long wing); naked selling is
refused by the Risk Guardian.

Think like a seller first (seller_lens): call-writing wall, put-writing wall, fresh OI writing near the money, PCR,
ATM straddle. Then the structure (choose):
  writers positioned against the direction  -> no trade
  IV high   -> SELL: credit spread, short strike at the writers' wall on the supporting side, wing opt_wing_strikes out
  IV low    -> BUY: ~0.55-delta call/put, only if the underlying's 1:2 point is short of the writers' wall
  IV normal -> BUY a debit spread: long ~0.50 delta, SELL the strike at the writers' wall
  writers boxing a range (index only) -> iron condor, short strikes at or beyond the two walls
  IV state: IV rank from MarketMiner's own chain snapshots, else ATM IV vs historical volatility. Selling needs
  >= opt_min_dte_sell days to expiry.

Prices: real FYERS quotes - BUY at the ask, SELL at the bid. Legs need two-sided quotes, tight spreads and open interest.
Payoff verification (payoff): expiry P&L on a grid through every strike; worst point = structural maximum loss; a
structure whose loss keeps growing above the highest strike is UNBOUNDED and refused.

Lots (2026-11-04, no lot rule): as many lots as fit the AI's per-trade risk and the day capital left (min 1). R per unit = |net delta| x underlying stop distance + spread
(buys) or opt_sell_stop_frac x credit (sells). Lot 1 books at 1:2 AFTER costs; lot 2's stop goes to breakeven and trails
opt_trail_r x R behind the best value. Exits also on the underlying's stop, a short strike breached, and 15:15 IST.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import math
import time

from backend.lab import costs as C
from backend.lab import options as LO

IST = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))
INDEX_SPOT = {"NIFTY": "NSE:NIFTY50-INDEX", "BANKNIFTY": "NSE:NIFTYBANK-INDEX", "FINNIFTY": "NSE:FINNIFTY-INDEX",
              "MIDCPNIFTY": "NSE:MIDCPNIFTY-INDEX", "SENSEX": "BSE:SENSEX-INDEX", "BANKEX": "BSE:BANKEX-INDEX"}
NON_STOCK = set(INDEX_SPOT) | {"NIFTYFPI", "NIFTYNXT50", "SENSEX50"}
CREDIT = ("credit_spread", "iron_condor")
LABEL = {"long_option": "Long option", "debit_spread": "Debit spread", "credit_spread": "Credit spread", "iron_condor": "Iron condor"}


class OptionsUnavailable(Exception):
    pass


def spot_symbol(underlying: str) -> str:
    u = underlying.upper()
    return INDEX_SPOT.get(u) or f"NSE:{u}-EQ"


def is_index(underlying: str) -> bool:
    return underlying.upper() in INDEX_SPOT


def underlying_of_symbol(symbol: str) -> str | None:
    s = symbol.upper()
    for k, v in INDEX_SPOT.items():
        if v == s:
            return k
    if s.startswith("NSE:") and s.endswith("-EQ"):
        return s[4:-3]
    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- data
async def quotes(symbols: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """FYERS quotes: {symbol: {lp, bid, ask, chp, volume}} for up to any number of symbols (50 per request)."""
    from backend.brokers.fyers.client import data_get
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    syms = list(dict.fromkeys(symbols))
    for i in range(0, len(syms), 50):
        p = await data_get("/quotes", {"symbols": ",".join(syms[i:i + 50])})
        for row in p.get("d") or []:
            v = row.get("v") or {}
            if row.get("s") == "ok":
                out[str(row.get("n")).upper()] = {"lp": _f(v.get("lp")), "bid": _f(v.get("bid")), "ask": _f(v.get("ask")),
                                                  "chp": _f(v.get("chp")), "volume": _f(v.get("volume")), "t": int(time.time())}
    return out


def _f(x):
    try:
        return float(x) if x is not None else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


async def chain(underlying: str, min_days: float = 0.0, strikes: int = 15) -> dict:
    """Real FYERS option chain for the first expiry at least `min_days` away, with lot and tick from the contract master."""
    from backend.brokers.fyers.client import data_get
    from backend.markets import fyers_master as FM
    sym = spot_symbol(underlying)
    first = await data_get("/options-chain-v3", {"symbol": sym, "strikecount": strikes, "timestamp": "", "greeks": "1"})
    d = first.get("data") or first
    now = time.time()
    exps = sorted(d.get("expiryData") or [], key=lambda e: int(e.get("expiry") or 0))
    exps = [e for e in exps if (int(e["expiry"]) + 10 * 3600 - now) / 86400 >= min_days]
    if not exps:
        raise OptionsUnavailable(f"no {underlying} expiry at least {min_days:g} days away")
    pick = exps[0]
    if str(pick.get("expiry")) != str(((d.get("expiryData") or [{}])[0]).get("expiry")):
        d = (await data_get("/options-chain-v3", {"symbol": sym, "strikecount": strikes, "timestamp": str(pick["expiry"]), "greeks": "1"})).get("data") or {}
    rows = d.get("optionsChain") or []
    spot = next((float(r.get("ltp") or 0) for r in rows if float(r.get("strike_price") or 0) <= 0), 0.0)
    by: dict[float, dict] = {}
    for r in rows:
        if r.get("option_type") not in ("CE", "PE"):
            continue
        g = r.get("greeks") or {}
        k = float(r["strike_price"])
        by.setdefault(k, {"strike": k})[r["option_type"]] = {
            "symbol": str(r.get("symbol") or "").upper(), "type": r["option_type"], "strike": k, "ltp": _f(r.get("ltp")) or 0,
            "bid": _f(r.get("bid")) or 0, "ask": _f(r.get("ask")) or 0, "oi": _f(r.get("oi")) or 0, "vol": _f(r.get("volume")) or 0,
            "iv": _f(g.get("iv")) or 0, "delta": _f(g.get("delta")) or 0, "theta": _f(g.get("theta")) or 0, "vega": _f(g.get("vega")) or 0,
            "gamma": _f(g.get("gamma")) or 0, "oi_chg": _f(r.get("oich")) or 0}
    if not by or not spot:
        raise OptionsUnavailable(f"FYERS returned an empty {underlying} chain")
    any_sym = next(v[s]["symbol"] for v in by.values() for s in ("CE", "PE") if s in v)
    c = await FM.contract(any_sym)
    lot = (c or {}).get("lot") or LO.LOTS.get(underlying.upper()) or 1
    tick = (c or {}).get("tick") or 0.05
    days = max(0.0, (int(pick["expiry"]) + 10 * 3600 - now) / 86400)
    st = [by[k] for k in sorted(by)]
    atm = min(st, key=lambda r: abs(r["strike"] - spot))
    ivs = [x for x in ((atm.get("CE") or {}).get("iv"), (atm.get("PE") or {}).get("iv")) if x]
    atm_iv = sum(ivs) / len(ivs) if ivs else None
    return {"underlying": underlying.upper(), "spot": spot, "expiry": pick.get("date"), "expiry_ts": int(pick["expiry"]), "days": days,
            "lot": lot, "tick": tick, "strikes": st, "atm_strike": atm["strike"], "atm_iv": atm_iv,
            "iv_rank": LO.iv_rank(underlying.upper(), atm_iv), "as_of": int(now), "source": "FYERS option chain + quotes"}


async def fno_stocks() -> list[str]:
    from backend.markets import fyers_master as FM
    return [u["underlying"] for u in await FM.underlyings("NSE") if u["underlying"] not in NON_STOCK and u.get("options")]


async def scan_movers(exclude: list[str], top: int) -> list[dict]:
    """Cheap pre-filter for 'scan all F&O': one quotes call per 50 stocks, ranked by |% change| (today's move)."""
    names = [u for u in await fno_stocks() if u not in exclude]
    q = await quotes([f"NSE:{u}-EQ" for u in names])
    ranked = sorted(({"underlying": u, **q[f"NSE:{u}-EQ"]} for u in names if f"NSE:{u}-EQ" in q and q[f"NSE:{u}-EQ"].get("chp") is not None),
                    key=lambda x: -abs(x["chp"] or 0))
    return ranked[:top]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- structures
def iv_state(ch: dict, hv_pct: float | None, r: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
    ivr = ch.get("iv_rank") or {}
    if ivr.get("available"):
        k = ivr["rank"]
        return ("high" if k >= r["opt_iv_high_rank"] else "low" if k <= r["opt_iv_low_rank"] else "normal"), f"IV rank {k:.0f}"
    iv = ch.get("atm_iv")
    if iv and hv_pct:
        x = iv / hv_pct
        return ("high" if x > 1.25 else "low" if x < 0.9 else "normal"), f"ATM IV {iv:.1f}% vs HV {hv_pct:.1f}% ({x:.2f}x; IV rank needs 20+ snapshots)"
    return "normal", "IV state unknown (no IV rank history or HV): treated as normal"


def _leg(ch: dict, typ: str, strike: float, side: str) -> dict | None:
    row = next((r for r in ch["strikes"] if r["strike"] == strike), None)
    o = (row or {}).get(typ)
    if not o:
        return None
    return {**o, "side": side, "expiry": ch.get("expiry"), "lot": ch["lot"]}


def _by_delta(ch: dict, typ: str, target: float, otm_of: float | None = None) -> dict | None:
    cands = [r[typ] for r in ch["strikes"] if r.get(typ) and r[typ].get("delta")]
    if otm_of is not None:
        cands = [o for o in cands if (o["strike"] > otm_of if typ == "CE" else o["strike"] < otm_of)]
    return min(cands, key=lambda o: abs(abs(o["delta"]) - target), default=None)


def _wing(ch: dict, typ: str, strike: float, n: int) -> float | None:
    ks = [r["strike"] for r in ch["strikes"] if r.get(typ)]
    if strike not in ks:
        return None
    i = ks.index(strike) + (n if typ == "CE" else -n)
    return ks[i] if 0 <= i < len(ks) else None


def leg_price(leg: dict, opening: bool = True) -> float | None:
    """Executable price: opening BUY at ask / SELL at bid; closing a long leg at bid / a short leg at ask."""
    buy = (leg["side"] == "BUY") == opening
    p = leg.get("ask") if buy else leg.get("bid")
    return p if p and p > 0 else None


def value(legs: list[dict], opening: bool = True) -> float | None:
    """Net position value per unit: + long legs, - short legs, at executable prices."""
    tot = 0.0
    for lg in legs:
        p = leg_price(lg, opening)
        if p is None:
            return None
        tot += p if lg["side"] == "BUY" else -p
    return tot


def seller_lens(ch: dict, r: dict) -> dict:
    """Read the chain the way an option WRITER would. Heavy put writing below spot = writers defending support
    (bullish); heavy call writing above = writers capping the move (bearish); both walls close together around spot =
    writers boxing a range. Fresh writing = OI added (oi_chg > 0) within +/-6 strikes; without OI-change data the
    put/call OI ratio is used instead. Walls = the strike with the most open interest above (calls) / below (puts)."""
    spot, rows = ch["spot"], ch["strikes"]
    ks = [x["strike"] for x in rows]
    step = (ks[1] - ks[0]) if len(ks) > 1 else 1.0
    above = [x for x in rows if x["strike"] >= spot and x.get("CE")]
    below = [x for x in rows if x["strike"] <= spot and x.get("PE")]
    call_wall = max(above, key=lambda x: x["CE"].get("oi") or 0)["strike"] if above else None
    put_wall = max(below, key=lambda x: x["PE"].get("oi") or 0)["strike"] if below else None
    band = [x for x in rows if abs(x["strike"] - spot) <= 6 * step]
    cw = sum(max(0.0, (x.get("CE") or {}).get("oi_chg") or 0) for x in band)
    pw = sum(max(0.0, (x.get("PE") or {}).get("oi_chg") or 0) for x in band)
    oi_ce = sum((x.get("CE") or {}).get("oi") or 0 for x in rows)
    oi_pe = sum((x.get("PE") or {}).get("oi") or 0 for x in rows)
    pcr = oi_pe / oi_ce if oi_ce else None
    atm = min(rows, key=lambda x: abs(x["strike"] - spot))
    mid = lambda o: ((o.get("bid") or 0) + (o.get("ask") or 0)) / 2 if o and o.get("bid") and o.get("ask") else (o or {}).get("ltp") or 0
    straddle = mid(atm.get("CE")) + mid(atm.get("PE"))
    k = r["opt_wall_writing_ratio"]
    basis = "fresh OI writing"
    if cw + pw > 0:
        view = "bullish" if pw > k * cw else "bearish" if cw > k * pw else None
    else:
        basis = "put/call OI ratio (no OI-change data)"
        view = "bullish" if (pcr or 1) >= 1.2 else "bearish" if (pcr or 1) <= 0.8 else None
    if view is None:
        boxed = call_wall is not None and put_wall is not None and straddle and (call_wall - put_wall) <= 2.5 * straddle
        view = "range" if boxed else "unclear"
    reads = [f"call-writing wall {call_wall:g}" if call_wall is not None else "no call wall",
             f"put-writing wall {put_wall:g}" if put_wall is not None else "no put wall",
             f"fresh writing calls {cw:,.0f} vs puts {pw:,.0f}", f"PCR {pcr:.2f}" if pcr else "PCR n/a",
             f"ATM straddle {straddle:,.2f} (expected move ~{straddle * 0.85:,.0f})"]
    return {"view": view, "basis": basis, "call_wall": call_wall, "put_wall": put_wall, "call_writing": cw, "put_writing": pw, "pcr": pcr,
            "straddle": straddle, "expected_move": straddle * 0.85, "reads": reads}


def _strike_leg(ch: dict, typ: str, strike: float | None) -> dict | None:
    if strike is None:
        return None
    row = next((x for x in ch["strikes"] if x["strike"] == strike), None)
    return (row or {}).get(typ)


def choose(direction: str, ch: dict, regime: str, ivs: str, r: dict, is_idx: bool, lens: dict | None = None,
           und: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
    """Think like a seller, then pick the structure. `und` = the underlying plan {entry, stop} for directional trades.
      writers against the direction           -> no trade
      IV high (premium is rich: sell it)       -> credit spread, short strike at the writers' wall on the supporting side
      IV low  (premium is cheap: buy it)       -> long call/put ~0.55 delta, only if the 1:2 target is short of the wall
      IV normal                                -> debit spread: buy ~0.50 delta, SELL the strike at the writers' wall
      NEUTRAL with writers boxing a range      -> iron condor, short strikes at (or beyond) the two walls"""
    lens = lens or seller_lens(ch, r)
    w = int(r["opt_wing_strikes"])
    spot = ch["spot"]
    extra = {}
    if direction == "NEUTRAL":
        if not is_idx:
            return None, "iron condors only on index options (stock option liquidity is too thin for four legs)"
        if lens["view"] != "range":
            return None, f"writers are not boxing a range (seller's view: {lens['view']})"
        if ch["days"] < r["opt_min_dte_sell"]:
            return None, f"{ch['days']:.1f} days to expiry: below the {r['opt_min_dte_sell']} minimum for selling"
        sc = _strike_leg(ch, "CE", lens["call_wall"]) if lens["call_wall"] and lens["call_wall"] > spot else None
        sp = _strike_leg(ch, "PE", lens["put_wall"]) if lens["put_wall"] and lens["put_wall"] < spot else None
        sc = sc if sc and abs(sc.get("delta") or 0) <= 0.35 else _by_delta(ch, "CE", r["opt_condor_delta"], spot)
        sp = sp if sp and abs(sp.get("delta") or 0) <= 0.35 else _by_delta(ch, "PE", r["opt_condor_delta"], spot)
        if not sc or not sp:
            return None, "no suitable short strikes"
        wc, wp = _wing(ch, "CE", sc["strike"], w), _wing(ch, "PE", sp["strike"], w)
        if wc is None or wp is None:
            return None, "chain too narrow for the wings"
        legs = [_leg(ch, "CE", sc["strike"], "SELL"), _leg(ch, "CE", wc, "BUY"), _leg(ch, "PE", sp["strike"], "SELL"), _leg(ch, "PE", wp, "BUY")]
        kind = "iron_condor"
    else:
        call = direction == "LONG"
        typ = "CE" if call else "PE"
        if (call and lens["view"] == "bearish") or (not call and lens["view"] == "bullish"):
            wall = lens["call_wall"] if call else lens["put_wall"]
            return None, (f"option writers are positioned against a {'rise' if call else 'fall'}: "
                          f"{'call' if call else 'put'} writing dominates, wall at {wall}")
        if ivs == "high":
            if ch["days"] < r["opt_min_dte_sell"]:
                return None, f"IV is high but {ch['days']:.1f} days to expiry is below the {r['opt_min_dte_sell']} minimum for selling"
            styp = "PE" if call else "CE"                 # sell where the writers defend: below spot for a rise, above for a fall
            wall = lens["put_wall"] if call else lens["call_wall"]
            s = _strike_leg(ch, styp, wall) if wall is not None and ((wall < spot) if call else (wall > spot)) else None
            if not s or abs(s.get("delta") or 0) > 0.45:
                s = _by_delta(ch, styp, r["opt_short_delta"], spot)
            wg = _wing(ch, styp, s["strike"], w) if s else None
            if not s or wg is None:
                return None, "no suitable credit-spread strikes"
            legs = [_leg(ch, styp, s["strike"], "SELL"), _leg(ch, styp, wg, "BUY")]
            kind = "credit_spread"
        else:
            if not und or und.get("stop") is None:
                return None, "no underlying stop for a buying trade"
            ur = abs(und["entry"] - und["stop"])
            tgt = und["entry"] + (2 if call else -2) * ur
            wall = lens["call_wall"] if call else lens["put_wall"]
            extra = {"und_risk": ur, "und_target_1": tgt, "wall": wall}
            if wall is not None and ((wall <= tgt) if call else (wall >= tgt)):
                return None, (f"the writers' {'call' if call else 'put'} wall at {wall:g} sits inside the 1:2 target {tgt:,.0f}: "
                              "sellers would cap the move before lot 1 books")
            b = _by_delta(ch, typ, 0.55 if ivs == "low" else 0.50)
            if not b:
                return None, "no option near the target delta"
            if ivs == "low":
                legs = [_leg(ch, typ, b["strike"], "BUY")]
                kind = "long_option"
            else:
                s = _strike_leg(ch, typ, wall) if wall is not None and ((wall > b["strike"]) if call else (wall < b["strike"])) else None
                s = s or _by_delta(ch, typ, r["opt_short_delta"], b["strike"])
                if not s:
                    return None, "no strike to sell against the long leg"
                legs = [_leg(ch, typ, b["strike"], "BUY"), _leg(ch, typ, s["strike"], "SELL")]
                kind = "debit_spread"
    if any(lg is None for lg in legs):
        return None, "a leg is missing from the chain"
    return {"kind": kind, "label": LABEL[kind], "direction": direction, "legs": legs, "underlying": ch["underlying"], "spot": spot,
            "expiry": ch["expiry"], "days": ch["days"], "lot": ch["lot"], "tick": ch["tick"], "iv_state": ivs, "atm_iv": ch.get("atm_iv"),
            "chain_as_of": ch["as_of"], "lens": lens, "und": {**(und or {}), **extra}}, \
        f"{LABEL[kind]} ({ivs} IV, {ch['days']:.1f} days; seller's view {lens['view']})"


def describe(st: dict) -> str:
    return f"{st['underlying']} {st['expiry']} " + " / ".join(
        f"{'+' if lg['side'] == 'BUY' else '-'}{lg['strike']:g}{lg['type']}" for lg in st["legs"]) + f" ({st['label']})"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- verification
def payoff(legs: list[dict], v0: float, spot: float) -> dict:
    """Expiry P&L per unit of the whole structure (v0 = net debit paid, negative for a net credit)."""
    ks = sorted({lg["strike"] for lg in legs})

    def pnl(s: float) -> float:
        tot = 0.0
        for lg in legs:
            intr = max(0.0, s - lg["strike"]) if lg["type"] == "CE" else max(0.0, lg["strike"] - s)
            tot += intr if lg["side"] == "BUY" else -intr
        return tot - v0

    grid = sorted({0.0, *ks, *(k * 0.999 for k in ks), *(k * 1.001 for k in ks), spot * 0.5, spot, spot * 2, spot * 4})
    pts = [(s, pnl(s)) for s in grid]
    hi = max(ks + [spot])
    unbounded = pnl(hi * 5) < pnl(hi * 4) - 1e-9          # P&L still falling above every strike -> uncapped loss
    worst = min(p for _, p in pts)
    best = max(p for _, p in pts)
    be = []
    for (s1, p1), (s2, p2) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        if (p1 < 0 <= p2) or (p1 >= 0 > p2):
            be.append(round(s1 + (s2 - s1) * (-p1) / (p2 - p1), 2) if p2 != p1 else s1)
    return {"max_loss": max(0.0, -worst), "max_gain": best, "unbounded": unbounded, "breakevens": be}


def covered(legs: list[dict]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Every short leg needs a long leg of the same type and expiry, further out of the money, with at least its qty."""
    for s in (lg for lg in legs if lg["side"] == "SELL"):
        wing = [lg for lg in legs if lg["side"] == "BUY" and lg["type"] == s["type"] and lg.get("expiry") == s.get("expiry")
                and (lg["strike"] > s["strike"] if s["type"] == "CE" else lg["strike"] < s["strike"])]
        if not wing:
            return False, f"short {s['strike']:g}{s['type']} has no protective long {s['type']} further out of the money (naked)"
    return True, "every short leg has a long wing" if any(lg["side"] == "SELL" for lg in legs) else "long options only"


def leg_liquidity(legs: list[dict], r: dict, is_idx: bool) -> list[str]:
    lim = r["opt_max_leg_spread_pct"] if is_idx else r["opt_max_leg_spread_pct_stock"]
    bad = []
    for lg in legs:
        b, a = lg.get("bid") or 0, lg.get("ask") or 0
        if b <= 0 or a <= 0 or a < b:
            bad.append(f"{lg['strike']:g}{lg['type']}: no two-sided quote")
            continue
        mid = (a + b) / 2
        if (a - b) / mid * 100 > lim:
            bad.append(f"{lg['strike']:g}{lg['type']}: spread {(a - b) / mid * 100:.1f}% > {lim}%")
        if (lg.get("oi") or 0) <= 0:
            bad.append(f"{lg['strike']:g}{lg['type']}: no open interest")
    return bad


def plan(st: dict, r: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Per-unit plan for a 2-lot trade. R (planned loss per unit):
      long option / debit spread  |net delta| x underlying stop distance + the legs' bid/ask spread, kept between
                                  opt_min_stop_pct% and opt_long_stop_pct% of the premium paid
      credit spread / condor      opt_sell_stop_frac x the credit received
    Lot 1 books at value v0 + 2R + fees per unit (1:2 after costs); lot 2 then moves its stop to v0 (breakeven) and trails
    opt_trail_r x R behind the best value seen. A credit structure whose 1:2 point is beyond 90% of its credit is refused."""
    legs = st["legs"]
    v0 = value(legs, True)
    if v0 is None:
        return None
    pf = payoff(legs, v0, st["spot"])
    k = st["kind"]
    need = {"long_option": 1, "debit_spread": 2, "credit_spread": 2, "iron_condor": 4}[k]
    pair = lambda a, b: abs(legs[a]["strike"] - legs[b]["strike"]) if len(legs) > max(a, b) else 0.0
    qty = st["lot"]                                        # fee estimate per unit on one lot (the most expensive case)
    fee_unit = fees(legs, qty) / qty if qty else 0.0
    width, ok, why = 0.0, True, ""
    if k in ("long_option", "debit_spread"):
        width = pair(0, 1) if k == "debit_spread" else 0.0
        nd = abs(sum((lg.get("delta") or 0) * (1 if lg["side"] == "BUY" else -1) for lg in legs))
        spr = sum((lg.get("ask") or 0) - (lg.get("bid") or 0) for lg in legs)
        ur = (st.get("und") or {}).get("und_risk") or 0
        R = nd * ur + spr if ur else v0 * r["opt_long_stop_pct"] / 100
        R = min(max(R, v0 * r["opt_min_stop_pct"] / 100), v0 * r["opt_long_stop_pct"] / 100)
        tp1 = v0 + 2 * (R + fee_unit) + fee_unit            # lot 1 nets 2 x (R + its fees) after its own fees
        if k == "debit_spread" and tp1 > width * 0.95:
            ok, why = False, f"1:2 value {tp1:,.2f} is beyond the spread's maximum {width:g}"
    else:
        credit = -v0
        width = pair(0, 1) if k == "credit_spread" else max(pair(0, 1), pair(2, 3))
        R = r["opt_sell_stop_frac"] * credit
        tp1 = v0 + 2 * (R + fee_unit) + fee_unit
        if tp1 > v0 + 0.9 * credit:
            ok, why = False, f"1:2 after costs needs {(tp1 - v0) / credit * 100:.0f}% of the credit (max 90%)"
    if len(legs) != need:                                  # malformed (e.g. a wing removed): the Guardian rejects it
        pf = {**pf, "unbounded": pf["unbounded"] or k in CREDIT}
    return {"v0": v0, "width": width, "max_loss_unit": pf["max_loss"], "planned_loss_unit": R, "gain_unit": tp1 - v0,
            "sl_value": v0 - R, "tp1_value": tp1, "tp_value": tp1, "trail_unit": R * r["opt_trail_r"], "fee_unit": fee_unit,
            "payoff": pf, "rr_ok": ok, "rr_why": why, "credit_ratio": (-v0 / width) if k in CREDIT and width else None}


def fees(legs: list[dict], qty: float, exit_values: dict | None = None) -> float:
    """Round-trip statutory fees for all legs (Indian options rates in lab/costs.py); exit at the given per-leg prices,
    else at the entry prices (the estimate used for sizing)."""
    tot = 0.0
    for lg in legs:
        e = leg_price(lg, True) or 0
        x = (exit_values or {}).get(lg["symbol"], e)
        tot += C.round_trip(lg["symbol"], "FNO", qty, e, x, lg["side"] == "BUY")
    return tot


def size(st: dict, p: dict, budget: float, r: dict, max_capital: float | None = None) -> dict:
    """As many lots as fit: planned loss at the stop (incl. fees) <= the per-trade risk, and the capital the position
    ties up (premium paid; worst-case loss for credit structures) <= max_capital when given. Minimum 1 lot."""
    lot = st["lot"]
    credit = st["kind"] in CREDIT

    def calc(n: int) -> dict:
        q = lot * n
        f = fees(st["legs"], q)
        return {"q": q, "f": f, "planned": q * p["planned_loss_unit"] + f, "structural": q * p["max_loss_unit"] + f,
                "premium": q * abs(p["v0"])}

    per_lot = lot * p["planned_loss_unit"] + fees(st["legs"], lot)
    n = max(1, int(budget // per_lot)) if per_lot > 0 else 1
    n = min(n, 200)
    c = calc(n)
    while n > 1 and c["planned"] > budget + 1e-6:
        n -= 1
        c = calc(n)
    cap_x = budget * r["option_premium_risk_x"]             # worst case at expiry also bounds the lot count
    while n > 1 and c["structural"] > cap_x + 1e-6:
        n -= 1
        c = calc(n)
    used = lambda c: c["structural"] if credit else c["premium"]
    if max_capital is not None:
        while n > 1 and used(c) > max_capital + 1e-6:
            n -= 1
            c = calc(n)
    base = {"lot": lot, "lots": n, "budget": round(budget, 2), "fees": round(c["f"], 2), "max_loss": round(c["planned"], 2),
            "structural_max_loss": round(c["structural"], 2), "premium": round(c["premium"], 2), "currency": "INR"}
    if c["planned"] > budget + 1e-6:
        return {**base, "qty": 0, "why": f"one lot ({lot}) risks {c['planned']:,.0f} at the stop, more than the AI's {budget:,.0f} per-trade risk"}
    if max_capital is not None and used(c) > max_capital + 1e-6:
        return {**base, "qty": 0, "why": f"one lot ties up {used(c):,.0f} INR, more than the {max_capital:,.0f} day capital left"}
    q = c["q"]
    bq = (n // 2) * lot
    h = bq if bq else q
    share = h / q
    lot1_gain = h * (p["tp1_value"] - p["v0"]) - c["f"] * share
    lot1_loss = h * p["planned_loss_unit"] + c["f"] * share
    return {**base, "qty": q, "book_qty": bq, "target_gain": round(lot1_gain, 2), "rr_net": round(lot1_gain / lot1_loss, 2) if lot1_loss else 0}
backend/agent/pbook.py:
"""Profit booking or fresh selling? For every options-desk index, read the pullback from today's extreme together with
what option writers did over the same minutes. Information only.

Inputs (all real, nothing assumed):
  * today's 15m move from retrace.py: direction, start, extreme (and when it printed), depth given back, Fibonacci levels
  * the per-minute option-chain snapshots recorded by straddle.py (open interest per strike, ATM straddle IV)
OI change is measured from the snapshot at the time of today's extreme to the latest one, over the strikes present in
both within +/- 6 strikes of the current ATM (so a moving ATM window does not create fake changes).

Reading for a pullback in an UP-move (mirror for a bounce in a down-move: call writers <-> put writers):
  TRENDING                 given back < 10% of today's leg: no profit booking yet
  PROFIT BOOKING           price off the high, call OI not building (< +3%), put OI holding (> -3%): longs taking profit,
                           writers are not betting against the move -> pullback inside the trend
  PROFIT BOOKING + UNWIND  call OI not building but put OI falling: put writers (support) are leaving -> deeper pullback risk
  FRESH SELLING            call OI building (>= +3%) while price falls: writers adding against the move
  REVERSAL RISK            call OI building AND put OI falling, or today's 78.6% level broken
Depth zones: 23.6-38.2% normal profit booking, 38.2-61.8% deeper, 61.8-78.6% last line, beyond 78.6% the move is reversing.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time

from . import db
from . import straddle as SD

TH = 3.0          # % change in OI that counts as building / unwinding
BAND = 6          # strikes either side of the current ATM


def _oi(row: dict) -> dict:
    return (db.jload(row.get("payload"), {}) or {}).get("oi") or {}


def oi_change(a: dict, b: dict, atm: float, step: float) -> dict | None:
    """CE / PE OI change (%, absolute) over the strikes in both snapshots within BAND strikes of atm."""
    if not a or not b or not step:
        return None
    ks = [k for k in b if k in a and abs(float(k) - atm) <= BAND * step + 1e-6]
    if len(ks) < 3:
        return None
    ce0, pe0 = sum(a[k][0] for k in ks), sum(a[k][1] for k in ks)
    ce1, pe1 = sum(b[k][0] for k in ks), sum(b[k][1] for k in ks)
    pc = lambda x0, x1: (x1 - x0) / x0 * 100 if x0 else None
    return {"strikes": len(ks), "ce_from": ce0, "ce_now": ce1, "pe_from": pe0, "pe_now": pe1, "ce_chg": ce1 - ce0, "pe_chg": pe1 - pe0,
            "ce_pct": pc(ce0, ce1), "pe_pct": pc(pe0, pe1), "pcr_from": pe0 / ce0 if ce0 else None, "pcr_now": pe1 / ce1 if ce1 else None}


def classify(trend: str, depth: float | None, status: str | None, oi: dict | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Pure: (verdict, plain-language reading)."""
    if trend not in ("bullish", "bearish") or depth is None:
        return "RANGE", "No clear move today: nothing to book yet"
    up = trend == "bullish"
    move, back = ("up-move", "off the high") if up else ("down-move", "off the low")
    if status == "REVERSAL":
        return "REVERSAL", f"Today's {move} has given back more than 78.6%: this is no longer profit booking"
    if depth < 10:
        return "TRENDING", f"Price is near today's {'high' if up else 'low'} ({depth:.0f}% given back): no profit booking yet"
    if not oi or oi.get("ce_pct") is None or oi.get("pe_pct") is None:
        return "PULLBACK", f"Pulling back {depth:.0f}% {back}; option OI since the extreme is not recorded yet, so who is driving it is unknown"
    against, support = (oi["ce_pct"], oi["pe_pct"]) if up else (oi["pe_pct"], oi["ce_pct"])
    wa, ws = ("call", "put") if up else ("put", "call")
    if against >= TH and support <= -TH:
        return "REVERSAL_RISK", (f"{wa.title()} writing +{against:.1f}% and {ws} OI {support:.1f}% while price is {depth:.0f}% {back}: "
                                 f"writers are switching sides - reversal risk")
    if against >= TH:
        return "FRESH_SELLING" if up else "FRESH_BUYING", (f"{wa.title()} writers adding +{against:.1f}% while price is {depth:.0f}% {back}: "
                                                          f"fresh {'selling' if up else 'buying'} against the move, not just profit booking")
    if support <= -TH:
        return "BOOKING_UNWIND", (f"{'Profit booking' if up else 'Short covering'} with {ws} writers leaving ({support:.1f}%): "
                                  f"support is thinning - a deeper pullback is possible")
    return ("PROFIT_BOOKING" if up else "SHORT_COVERING"), (f"{'Profit booking' if up else 'Short covering'}: price {depth:.0f}% {back}, {wa} OI "
                                                            f"{against:+.1f}% (not building), {ws} OI {support:+.1f}% (holding) - a pullback inside today's {move}")


def zone(depth: float | None) -> str | None:
    if depth is None:
        return None
    return ("shallow (< 23.6%)" if depth < 23.6 else "normal profit booking (23.6-38.2%)" if depth < 38.2 else
            "deeper (38.2-61.8%)" if depth < 61.8 else "last line (61.8-78.6%)" if depth <= 78.6 else "beyond 78.6%: reversing")


def index_view(x: dict) -> dict:
    """x: one index from retrace.report()."""
    und = x["und"]
    m = (x.get("timeframes") or {}).get("15m") or {}
    out = {"und": und, "close": m.get("close"), "trend": m.get("trend"), "depth_pct": m.get("depth_pct"), "status": m.get("status"),
           "leg_start": m.get("leg_start"), "leg_end": m.get("leg_end"), "leg_end_time": m.get("leg_end_time"), "fib": m.get("fib"),
           "zone": zone(m.get("depth_pct")), "oi": None, "iv_chg": None}
    SD._init()
    last = db.q("SELECT * FROM straddle_snapshots WHERE und=? ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1", (und,), one=True)
    if last and m.get("leg_end_time"):
        d0, d1 = SD._session_bounds(last["t"])
        at = max(m["leg_end_time"], d0)
        ref = (db.q("SELECT * FROM straddle_snapshots WHERE und=? AND t>=? AND t<? AND t<=? ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1",
                    (und, d0, d1, at + 900), one=True)
               or db.q("SELECT * FROM straddle_snapshots WHERE und=? AND t>=? AND t<? ORDER BY t LIMIT 1", (und, d0, d1), one=True))
        if ref and ref["t"] < last["t"] and ref.get("expiry") == last.get("expiry"):
            out["oi"] = oi_change(_oi(ref), _oi(last), last["atm"], last["step"] or 0)
            if out["oi"]:
                out["oi"].update(since=ref["t"], to=last["t"], expiry=last.get("expiry"))
            if ref.get("iv") and last.get("iv"):
                out["iv_chg"] = last["iv"] - ref["iv"]
        out["snapshot_at"] = last["t"]
    v, txt = classify(m.get("trend"), m.get("depth_pct"), m.get("status"), out["oi"])
    out.update(verdict=v, reading=txt)
    if out["iv_chg"] is not None and v not in ("TRENDING", "RANGE"):
        out["reading"] += f"; ATM IV {out['iv_chg']:+.1f} since the extreme" + (" (fear rising)" if out["iv_chg"] > 0.5 else "")
    return out


async def report() -> dict:
    from . import retrace as RT
    r = await RT.report()
    return {"indices": [index_view(x) for x in r.get("indices") or [] if x.get("timeframes")], "updating": r.get("updating"),
            "note": "Move and depth: today's 15m leg (closed candles). OI: FYERS option chain snapshots taken every minute, from the time of "
                    f"today's extreme to now, over +/-{BAND} strikes of ATM; +/-{TH:g}% counts as building / unwinding. Information only.",
            "at": int(time.time())}
backend/agent/performance.py:
"""Performance intelligence for the agent's own book (never mixed with the Lab ledger, the Telegram bot or the Day
Desk). Cross-currency figures are in R (P&L / initial stop risk, after costs); money figures are per currency.

Metrics: trades, wins, losses, win rate, average win/loss (R and money), profit factor, expectancy with a 95%
confidence interval, max drawdown (R and % of equity), Sharpe and Sortino per trade, longest win/loss streaks,
costs, entry slippage, capital utilisation (risk and notional as % of equity), breakdowns by strategy, instrument,
timeframe, regime and session. Win rate is never used on its own.

Degradation (degradation_check): a strategy with >= 15 closed agent trades whose LAST 15 trades have expectancy
< -0.15R and profit factor < 0.8 is SUSPENDED from new agent paper trades (reason logged). If the strategy is
validated by backtest for a symbol/timeframe and its last 15 live-paper trades are below zero, a degradation alert is
raised even before suspension. Only the user can resume a suspended strategy.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import statistics

from . import config as CFG
from . import db
from . import guardian as G


def _streaks(rs: list[float]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    w = l = bw = bl = 0
    for r in rs:
        if r > 0:
            w, l = w + 1, 0
        else:
            l, w = l + 1, 0
        bw, bl = max(bw, w), max(bl, l)
    return bw, bl


def stats(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
    n = len(rows)
    if not n:
        return {"trades": 0}
    rs = [r["r_result"] or 0 for r in rows]
    w = [x for x in rs if x > 0]
    lo = [x for x in rs if x <= 0]
    mean = sum(rs) / n
    sd = statistics.stdev(rs) if n > 1 else 0
    down = [min(0, x) for x in rs]
    dd_sd = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in down) / n) if n else 0
    eq = peak = mdd = 0.0
    for x in rs:
        eq += x
        peak = max(peak, eq)
        mdd = min(mdd, eq - peak)
    bw, bl = _streaks(rs)
    money: dict = {}
    for cur in ("INR", "USD"):
        c = [r for r in rows if r["currency"] == cur]
        if c:
            pw = [r["pnl"] for r in c if (r["pnl"] or 0) > 0]
            pl = [r["pnl"] for r in c if (r["pnl"] or 0) <= 0]
            money[cur] = {"trades": len(c), "pnl": round(sum(r["pnl"] or 0 for r in c), 2), "avg_profit": round(sum(pw) / len(pw), 2) if pw else 0,
                          "avg_loss": round(sum(pl) / len(pl), 2) if pl else 0, "costs": round(sum(r["costs"] or 0 for r in c), 2)}
    slip = [db.jload(r.get("payload"), {}).get("entry_slippage", 0) / (abs(r["entry"] - r["stop"]) or 1) for r in rows if r.get("payload")]
    half = 1.96 * sd / math.sqrt(n) if n > 1 else None
    return {"trades": n, "wins": len(w), "losses": len(lo), "win_rate": round(100 * len(w) / n, 1),
            "avg_win_r": round(sum(w) / len(w), 3) if w else 0, "avg_loss_r": round(sum(lo) / len(lo), 3) if lo else 0,
            "profit_factor": round(sum(w) / -sum(lo), 2) if lo and sum(lo) < 0 else None,
            "expectancy_r": round(mean, 3), "expectancy_r_ci95": [round(mean - half, 3), round(mean + half, 3)] if half is not None else [None, None],
            "total_r": round(sum(rs), 2), "max_drawdown_r": round(mdd, 2),
            "sharpe_per_trade": round(mean / sd, 3) if sd else None, "sortino_per_trade": round(mean / dd_sd, 3) if dd_sd else None,
            "max_win_streak": bw, "max_loss_streak": bl, "money": money,
            "avg_entry_slippage_r": round(sum(slip) / len(slip), 3) if slip else None}


def _group(rows, key):
    g: dict = {}
    for r in rows:
        g.setdefault(str(r.get(key)), []).append(r)
    return {k: stats(v) for k, v in sorted(g.items())}


def summary(mode: str = "paper") -> dict:
    rows = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_trades WHERE status='closed' AND mode=? ORDER BY closed_at, id", (mode,))
    out = stats(rows)
    out.update(by_strategy=_group(rows, "strategy"), by_symbol=_group(rows, "symbol"), by_tf=_group(rows, "tf"),
               by_regime=_group(rows, "regime"), by_session=_group(rows, "session"))
    eqs, util = {}, {}
    dd_pct = 0.0
    for cur in ("INR", "USD"):
        bk = G.book(cur, mode=mode)
        c = [r for r in rows if r["currency"] == cur]
        curve, e, pk, worst = [], bk["capital"], bk["capital"], 0.0
        for r in c:
            e += r["pnl"] or 0
            pk = max(pk, e)
            worst = max(worst, (pk - e) / pk * 100 if pk else 0)
            curve.append({"t": r["closed_at"], "equity": round(e, 2)})
        eqs[cur] = {"capital": bk["capital"], "equity": round(bk["equity"], 2), "peak": round(bk["peak"], 2),
                    "drawdown_pct": round(bk["drawdown_pct"], 2), "max_drawdown_pct": round(worst, 2),
                    "day_pnl": round(bk["day_pnl"], 2), "week_pnl": round(bk["week_pnl"], 2), "curve": curve[-300:]}
        dd_pct = max(dd_pct, worst)                       # worst historical peak-to-trough, not just today's
        if c:
            util[cur] = {"avg_risk_pct_of_equity": round(100 * sum((r["risk_amount"] or 0) for r in c) / len(c) / bk["capital"], 3),
                         "avg_notional_x": round(sum(abs(r["qty"] * r["entry"]) for r in c) / len(c) / bk["capital"], 3)}
    out.update(equity=eqs, capital_utilisation=util, max_drawdown_pct=round(dd_pct, 2),
               note="Paper results from MarketMiner's own simulated fills (real candles, modelled costs). Small samples are noise; see the 95% interval.")
    return out


def degradation_check() -> list[str]:
    msgs = []
    for row in db.q("SELECT DISTINCT strategy FROM agent_trades WHERE status='closed'"):
        k = row["strategy"]
        rs = db.q("SELECT r_result, symbol, tf FROM agent_trades WHERE status='closed' AND strategy=? ORDER BY closed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 15", (k,))
        if len(rs) < 15:
            continue
        s = stats([{**r, "currency": "", "pnl": 0, "costs": 0, "entry": 1, "stop": 0} for r in rs])
        exp, pf = s["expectancy_r"], s["profit_factor"]
        st = db.q("SELECT status FROM agent_strategy_status WHERE strategy=?", (k,), one=True)
        if exp < -0.15 and (pf is None or pf < 0.8) and (st or {}).get("status") != "suspended":
            reason = f"last 15 agent trades: expectancy {exp:+.2f}R, profit factor {pf}"
            db.execute("INSERT INTO agent_strategy_status(strategy, status, reason, t) VALUES(?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(strategy) DO UPDATE SET "
                       "status=excluded.status, reason=excluded.reason, t=excluded.t", (k, "suspended", reason, db.now()))
            db.log("learning", f"Strategy {k} SUSPENDED from new paper trades: {reason}", level="warn")
            msgs.append(f"{k} suspended")
        elif exp < 0:
            from backend.lab import store
            if any((store.get_setting(f"validation:{r['symbol']}:{r['tf']}") or {}).get("status", {}).get(k, {}).get("status") == "validated" for r in rs):
                db.log("learning", f"Degradation alert: {k} is backtest-validated but its last 15 agent trades average {exp:+.2f}R", level="warn")
                msgs.append(f"{k} degradation alert")
    return msgs


def set_strategy_status(strategy: str, status: str, reason: str, who: str = "user") -> dict:
    if status not in ("active", "suspended"):
        raise ValueError("status must be active or suspended")
    before = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_strategy_status WHERE strategy=?", (strategy,), one=True)
    db.execute("INSERT INTO agent_strategy_status(strategy, status, reason, t) VALUES(?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(strategy) DO UPDATE SET "
               "status=excluded.status, reason=excluded.reason, t=excluded.t", (strategy, status, reason, db.now()))
    db.config_change(who, f"strategy_status:{strategy}", before, {"status": status, "reason": reason})
    db.log("learning", f"Strategy {strategy} set {status} by {who}: {reason}")
    return {"strategy": strategy, "status": status}
backend/agent/research.py:
"""Strategy Research and Evolution Engine (sandboxed, approval-gated).

The research engine may only PROPOSE. It runs the Signal Lab backtester (next-open entries, costs, 60/20/20 split,
parameter grid on train only, 3-fold walk-forward, Monte Carlo) and records each result as an experiment. A proposal
changes nothing until the user approves it (POST /api/agent/research/{id}/approve); every approved change is versioned
in agent_config_history and can be rolled back. It can never touch capital limits, risk policy, execution permissions
or code: the only things an approved experiment can change are, per symbol/timeframe/strategy,
  * the agent's minimum score for that strategy        (kind "threshold")
  * whether the agent may trade that strategy at all   (kind "suspend" / "activate")

Promotion rules (judge): a challenger is ELIGIBLE only when ALL hold
  1. out-of-sample (validation + test) trades >= 30
  2. validation AND test expectancy > 0
  3. out-of-sample expectancy beats the champion's by >= 0.05R
  4. >= 2 of 3 walk-forward folds positive
  5. Monte Carlo share of negative runs <= 20%
  6. max drawdown (R) no worse than 1.25 x the champion's
  7. not overfit: test expectancy >= 30% of train expectancy, and >= 50% of the parameter-grid cells positive on
     validation (a lone good cell is luck)
Suspension proposals need >= 30 out-of-sample trades with validation and test expectancy both < 0 and Monte Carlo
negative share >= 60%.

factor_correlation measures the Signal Lab score factors' votes on real history and records pairs with |r| >= 0.6,
which intel.families_for then counts as one piece of evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import math

from backend.lab import backtest as B
from backend.lab import costs as C
from backend.lab import data as D
from backend.lab import scoring as SC
from backend.lab import store
from backend.lab.engine import Engine, MTF
from . import config as CFG
from . import db

MIN_OOS = 30


def _oos(res: dict) -> dict:
    v, t = res.get("validation") or {}, res.get("test") or {}
    n = (v.get("trades") or 0) + (t.get("trades") or 0)
    e = ((v.get("expectancy_r") or 0) * (v.get("trades") or 0) + (t.get("expectancy_r") or 0) * (t.get("trades") or 0)) / n if n else None
    return {"trades": n, "expectancy_r": e, "val": v.get("expectancy_r"), "test": t.get("expectancy_r")}


def judge(champ: dict, chall: dict) -> dict:
    """Pure function over two backtest results. Returns {eligible, reasons, facts}."""
    co, cc = _oos(champ), _oos(chall)
    reasons, ok = [], True

    def need(cond: bool, text: str):
        nonlocal ok
        reasons.append(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + text)
        ok = ok and cond

    need(cc["trades"] >= MIN_OOS, f"out-of-sample trades {cc['trades']} >= {MIN_OOS}")
    need((cc["val"] or 0) > 0 and (cc["test"] or 0) > 0, f"validation {cc['val']} and test {cc['test']} expectancy > 0")
    need(cc["expectancy_r"] is not None and cc["expectancy_r"] >= (co["expectancy_r"] or 0) + 0.05,
         f"OOS expectancy {cc['expectancy_r'] and round(cc['expectancy_r'], 3)} vs champion {co['expectancy_r'] and round(co['expectancy_r'], 3)} (+0.05R needed)")
    wf = chall.get("walk_forward") or []
    pos = sum(1 for f in wf if (f.get("expectancy_r") or 0) > 0 and (f.get("trades") or 0) > 0)
    need(pos >= 2, f"{pos}/3 walk-forward folds positive")
    mc = chall.get("monte_carlo") or {}
    need(mc.get("available") and (mc.get("prob_negative") or 100) <= 20, f"Monte Carlo negative runs {mc.get('prob_negative')}% <= 20%")
    dd_c, dd_h = abs((chall.get("overall") or {}).get("max_drawdown_r") or 0), abs((champ.get("overall") or {}).get("max_drawdown_r") or 0)
    need(dd_h == 0 or dd_c <= 1.25 * dd_h, f"max drawdown {dd_c}R vs champion {dd_h}R (<= 1.25x)")
    tr = (chall.get("train") or {}).get("expectancy_r") or 0
    te = (chall.get("test") or {}).get("expectancy_r") or 0
    need(tr <= 0 or te >= 0.3 * tr, f"test expectancy {te} >= 30% of train {tr} (overfit check)")
    sens = chall.get("sensitivity") or []
    good = sum(1 for c in sens if ((c.get("validation") or {}).get("expectancy_r") or 0) > 0)
    need(not sens or good >= len(sens) / 2, f"{good}/{len(sens)} parameter cells positive on validation (robustness)")
    return {"eligible": ok, "reasons": reasons, "facts": {"champion_oos": co, "challenger_oos": cc}}


def judge_suspend(res: dict) -> dict:
    o = _oos(res)
    mc = res.get("monte_carlo") or {}
    cond = o["trades"] >= MIN_OOS and (o["val"] or 0) < 0 and (o["test"] or 0) < 0 and (mc.get("prob_negative") or 0) >= 60
    return {"eligible": cond, "reasons": [f"OOS trades {o['trades']}", f"validation {o['val']}, test {o['test']}",
                                          f"Monte Carlo negative {mc.get('prob_negative')}%"], "facts": o}


async def _engine(symbol: str, tf: str, bars: int):
    main, q = await D.candles(symbol, tf, bars)
    itf, htf = MTF[tf]
    ib = (await D.candles(symbol, itf, min(5000, bars)))[0] if itf else None
    hb = (await D.candles(symbol, htf, min(3000, bars)))[0] if htf and htf != itf else ib
    return Engine(main, tf, D.market_of(symbol), D.session_key(symbol), D.anchor_minutes(symbol), ib, hb), q


async def backtest(symbol: str, tf: str, strategy: str | None, min_score: float | None, bars: int = 3000) -> dict:
    E, q = await _engine(symbol, tf, bars)
    cost_cfg = {**C.DEFAULTS, **(store.get_setting("costs") or {})}
    res = await asyncio.to_thread(B.run, E, symbol, store.get_setting("strategies") or {}, min_score, cost_cfg, strategy)
    res["data_quality"] = q
    return res


def _save(symbol, tf, strategy, kind, params, result_summary, verdict, status) -> int:
    return db.execute("INSERT INTO agent_experiments(t, symbol, tf, strategy, kind, params, result, verdict, status) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                      (db.now(), symbol, tf, strategy, kind, json.dumps(params), json.dumps(result_summary, default=str), json.dumps(verdict), status))


def _brief(res: dict) -> dict:
    return {k: res.get(k) for k in ("overall", "train", "validation", "test", "walk_forward", "monte_carlo", "params", "notes", "candles", "from", "to")}


def thresholds() -> dict:
    return store.get_setting("agent_thresholds") or {}


async def research_strategy(symbol: str, tf: str, strategy: str, bars: int = 3000) -> list[int]:
    """Champion = the agent's current minimum score for this strategy. Challengers = +5 and +10 points."""
    r = CFG.risk()
    key = f"{symbol}|{tf}|{strategy}"
    cur = float(thresholds().get(key, r["min_score"]))
    champ = await backtest(symbol, tf, strategy, cur, bars)
    if champ.get("error"):
        return [_save(symbol, tf, strategy, "threshold", {"min_score": cur}, {"error": champ["error"]}, {"eligible": False, "reasons": [champ["error"]]}, "rejected")]
    ids = []
    sus = judge_suspend(champ)
    if sus["eligible"]:
        ids.append(_save(symbol, tf, strategy, "suspend", {}, _brief(champ), sus, "eligible"))
    for ch in (cur + 5, cur + 10):
        if ch > 95:
            continue
        chall = await backtest(symbol, tf, strategy, ch, bars)
        v = judge(champ, chall) if not chall.get("error") else {"eligible": False, "reasons": [chall["error"]]}
        ids.append(_save(symbol, tf, strategy, "threshold", {"min_score": ch, "champion_min_score": cur},
                         {"champion": _brief(champ), "challenger": _brief(chall)}, v, "eligible" if v["eligible"] else "rejected"))
    db.log("research", f"Research {strategy} on {symbol} {tf}: {len(ids)} experiment(s) recorded", symbol)
    return ids


async def research_symbol(symbol: str, tf: str, bars: int = 3000) -> dict:
    """Full backtest (all strategies) -> per-strategy profile; then per-strategy experiments for the ones with data."""
    full = await backtest(symbol, tf, None, None, bars)
    if full.get("error"):
        db.log("research", f"Research skipped for {symbol} {tf}: {full['error']}", symbol, level="warn")
        return {"error": full["error"]}
    prof = {"by_strategy": full.get("by_strategy"), "by_regime": full.get("by_regime"), "validation_status": full.get("validation_status"),
            "overall": full.get("overall"), "at": db.now()}
    store.set_setting(f"agent_profile:{symbol}:{tf}", prof)
    ids = []
    for k, s in (full.get("by_strategy") or {}).items():
        if (s.get("trades") or 0) >= 20:
            ids += await research_strategy(symbol, tf, k, bars)
    try:
        await factor_correlation(symbol, tf)
    except Exception as exc:                              # noqa: BLE001
        db.log("research", f"Factor correlation failed for {symbol}: {str(exc)[:120]}", symbol, level="warn")
    return {"profile": prof, "experiments": ids}


def _pearson(xs, ys) -> float | None:
    pts = [(x, y) for x, y in zip(xs, ys) if x is not None and y is not None]
    if len(pts) < 50:
        return None
    mx = sum(p[0] for p in pts) / len(pts)
    my = sum(p[1] for p in pts) / len(pts)
    sx = math.sqrt(sum((p[0] - mx) ** 2 for p in pts))
    sy = math.sqrt(sum((p[1] - my) ** 2 for p in pts))
    if not sx or not sy:
        return None
    return sum((p[0] - mx) * (p[1] - my) for p in pts) / (sx * sy)


def correlation_from_engine(E: Engine, start: int = 210, every: int = 1) -> dict:
    keys = list(SC.WEIGHTS)
    series = {k: [] for k in keys}
    for i in range(start, len(E.F.bars), every):
        v = SC.factors(E.F, i, E.ctx(i))
        for k in keys:
            series[k].append(v.get(k))
    mat, red = {}, []
    for a_ in keys:
        for b_ in keys:
            if a_ < b_:
                r = _pearson(series[a_], series[b_])
                if r is not None:
                    mat[f"{a_}~{b_}"] = round(r, 3)
                    if abs(r) >= 0.6:
                        red.append([a_, b_, round(r, 3)])
    return {"matrix": mat, "redundant": red, "samples": len(series[keys[0]])}


async def factor_correlation(symbol: str, tf: str, bars: int = 2000) -> dict:
    E, _ = await _engine(symbol, tf, bars)
    res = await asyncio.to_thread(correlation_from_engine, E, 210, 2)
    res["at"] = db.now()
    store.set_setting(f"agent_corr:{symbol}:{tf}", res)
    db.log("research", f"Factor correlation {symbol} {tf}: {len(res['redundant'])} redundant pair(s) "
           + ", ".join(f"{a}~{b} {r:+.2f}" for a, b, r in res["redundant"]), symbol)
    return res


def approve(exp_id: int, who: str = "user") -> dict:
    e = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_experiments WHERE id=?", (exp_id,), one=True)
    if not e:
        raise ValueError("no such experiment")
    if e["status"] != "eligible":
        raise PermissionError(f"experiment is {e['status']}: only eligible experiments can be approved")
    p = db.jload(e["params"], {})
    key = f"{e['symbol']}|{e['tf']}|{e['strategy']}"
    if e["kind"] == "threshold":
        before = thresholds()
        after = {**before, key: float(p["min_score"])}
        db.config_change(who, "agent_thresholds", before, after)
        store.set_setting("agent_thresholds", after)
    elif e["kind"] == "suspend":
        from . import performance as PF
        PF.set_strategy_status(e["strategy"], "suspended", f"approved research #{exp_id}", who)
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown experiment kind")
    db.execute("UPDATE agent_experiments SET status='approved' WHERE id=?", (exp_id,))
    db.log("research", f"Experiment #{exp_id} ({e['kind']} {key}) APPROVED by {who}")
    return {"ok": True, "id": exp_id}


def rollback(history_id: int, who: str = "user") -> dict:
    h = db.q("SELECT * FROM agent_config_history WHERE id=?", (history_id,), one=True)
    if not h or h["key"] != "agent_thresholds":
        raise ValueError("only agent_thresholds changes can be rolled back here (risk settings: save the old values)")
    before = db.jload(h["before"], {})
    cur = thresholds()
    db.config_change(who, "agent_thresholds", cur, before)
    store.set_setting("agent_thresholds", before)
    db.log("research", f"Rolled back threshold change #{history_id} ({who})")
    return {"ok": True, "restored": before}
backend/agent/service.py:
"""Agent orchestrator: the autonomous decision pipeline, run inside the MarketMiner server (no browser needed).

Every loop (loop_seconds, default 60 s):
  1. POSITION MONITORING   open agent positions are advanced on 1-minute candles (always, even when the agent is
                           stopped, so stops and targets keep working); closed ones go to POST-TRADE ANALYSIS
                           (learning.review), the drawdown halt check and the strategy degradation check.
  2. For each watch-list symbol whose next candle has closed (and whose market is open):
       MARKET DATA                 lab.analysis.analyze(closed candles only)
       DATA QUALITY VALIDATION     intel.quality_gate
       MARKET REGIME DETECTION     agents.regime_agent
       MARKET STRUCTURE ANALYSIS   agents.structure_agent / options_agent
       STRATEGY SELECTION          agents.strategy_agent (regime fit, suspensions, own record)
       TRADE SETUP GENERATION      agents.setup_agent (best eligible setup only: one idea per symbol per candle)
       INDEPENDENT RISK VALIDATION guardian.evaluate -> APPROVED / REJECTED / OBSERVE (intelligence mode)
       TRADE APPROVAL + PAPER EXECUTION   execution.open_position (single-use approval)
  3. Rejected / declined setups are followed up (resolve_untaken): did T1 or the stop come first? -> missed
     opportunities vs good rejections, shown in the Learning Centre.
  4. Optional nightly research (research_enabled): backtests, experiments, factor correlation. Proposals only.

Every observation, decision, check and action is written to the agent tables and the activity log.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import datetime as dt
import json
import time
import traceback

from backend.lab import analysis as A
from backend.lab import data as D
from backend.lab.candle import TF_SECONDS
from . import agents as AG
from . import config as CFG
from . import db
from . import execution as EX
from . import guardian as G
from . import ml as ML
from . import intel
from . import learning as L
from . import options as OP
from . import performance as PF
from . import research as RS

IST = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))
STATUS: dict = {"loop_running": False, "last_cycle": None, "last_error": None, "cycles": 0, "next_due": {}, "last_bar": {},
                "symbol_state": {}, "research": {"running": False, "last": None, "last_day": None}, "reconcile": None}
_task: asyncio.Task | None = None


def market_open(symbol: str, now: float) -> bool:
    m = D.market_of(symbol)
    if m not in ("NSE", "FNO", "MCX"):
        return True
    t = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(now, IST)
    mins = t.hour * 60 + t.minute
    if t.weekday() >= 5:
        return False
    return 555 <= mins <= 930 if m != "MCX" else 540 <= mins <= 1410


def _due(symbol: str, tf: str, now: float) -> bool:
    nd = STATUS["next_due"].get(f"{symbol}|{tf}")
    return nd is None or now >= nd


async def process_symbol(symbol: str, tf: str, now: float | None = None) -> dict:
    now = now or time.time()
    cfg, r = CFG.agent(), CFG.risk()
    mode = cfg["mode"]
    step = TF_SECONDS[tf]
    key = f"{symbol}|{tf}"
    try:
        a = await A.analyze(symbol, tf, 600, True, False)
    except D.DataUnavailable as exc:
        STATUS["symbol_state"][key] = {"t": int(now), "state": "DATA UNAVAILABLE", "detail": str(exc)[:200]}
        STATUS["next_due"][key] = now + 120
        db.log("data", f"DATA UNAVAILABLE {symbol} {tf}: {str(exc)[:200]} - no decisions", symbol, level="warn")
        return {"state": "data unavailable"}
    candles = a.get("candles") or []
    bar_time = candles[-1]["time"] if candles else 0
    STATUS["last_bar"][key] = bar_time
    STATUS["next_due"][key] = bar_time + 2 * step + 5          # next candle's close (+5 s for the feed)
    q = intel.quality_gate(a.get("quality") or {}, tf, (a.get("quality") or {}).get("candles") or len(candles), now)
    pic = intel.picture(a)
    reg = AG.regime_agent(a, pic)
    struct = AG.structure_agent(a)
    opts = AG.options_agent(a, pic)
    obs = {"picture": pic, "regime": reg, "structure": struct, "options": opts, "quality": q}
    new = db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_observations(t, symbol, tf, bar_time, regime, volatility, quality_ok, data) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                     (int(now), symbol, tf, bar_time, reg["regime"], reg["volatility"], int(q["ok"]), json.dumps(obs, default=str)))
    STATUS["symbol_state"][key] = {"t": int(now), "bar_time": bar_time, "state": "observed", "regime": reg["label"], "volatility": reg["volatility"],
                                   "bias": pic.get("bias"), "quality_ok": q["ok"], "quality_blocks": q["blocks"], "close": pic.get("close"),
                                   "source": q.get("source"), "as_of": q.get("as_of")}
    if not new and db.q("SELECT id FROM agent_decisions WHERE symbol=? AND tf=? AND bar_time=? LIMIT 1", (symbol, tf, bar_time), one=True):
        return {"state": "already processed"}
    eligible, declined = AG.strategy_agent(a, reg)
    for s in declined:
        _decision(symbol, tf, bar_time, s, "declined_strategy", "DECLINED", {"why": s.get("_why")})
    if not eligible:
        n_setups = len([s for s in a.get("setups") or [] if s.get("time") == bar_time])
        db.log("analysis", f"{symbol} {tf}: {reg['label']}, bias {pic.get('bias')}; {n_setups} setup(s) on this candle, none eligible"
               + ("" if q["ok"] else f"; data: {'; '.join(q['blocks'])}"), symbol)
        return {"state": "no eligible setup"}
    eligible, ranked = _ml_rank(eligible)
    best, rest = eligible[0], eligible[1:]
    for s in rest:
        did_ = _decision(symbol, tf, bar_time, s, "not_selected", "DECLINED",
                         {"why": f"lower {'ML probability' if ranked else 'score'} than {best['strategy']} on the same candle"})
        ML.record(did_, symbol, tf, s, s.get("_ml"))
    setup = AG.setup_agent(best, a, pic, reg)
    setup["ml"] = best.get("_ml")
    thr = RS.thresholds().get(f"{symbol}|{tf}|{best['strategy']}")
    ctx = {"quality": q, "picture": pic, "evidence": setup["evidence"], "avg_volume": intel.avg_volume(a), "mode": mode,
           "strategy_status": AG.strategy_status(best["strategy"]), "min_score": thr, "ml": best.get("_ml")}
    g = G.evaluate(setup, ctx, now)
    g["quality"] = q
    stage = {"APPROVED": "approved", "REJECTED": "rejected_guardian", "OBSERVE": "observe"}[g["verdict"]]
    did = _decision(symbol, tf, bar_time, setup, stage, g["verdict"], g)
    ML.record(did, symbol, tf, best, best.get("_ml"))
    if g["verdict"] == "REJECTED":
        db.log("guardian", f"REJECTED {setup['direction']} {symbol} ({setup['strategy']}, score {setup['score']:.0f}): " + "; ".join(g["failed"]),
               symbol, {"decision_id": did})
        return {"state": "rejected", "decision_id": did, "failed": g["failed"]}
    if g["verdict"] == "OBSERVE":
        db.log("guardian", f"Intelligence mode: {setup['direction']} {symbol} ({setup['strategy']}) passed all checks - no order", symbol, {"decision_id": did})
        return {"state": "observe", "decision_id": did}
    db.log("guardian", f"APPROVED {setup['direction']} {symbol} ({setup['strategy']}, score {setup['score']:.0f}), size {g['sizing']['qty']:g}, "
           f"max loss {g['sizing']['max_loss']:,.2f} {g['sizing']['currency']}", symbol, {"decision_id": did})
    res = await EX.open_position(did, now)
    return {"state": "executed" if res.get("ok") else "execution skipped", "decision_id": did, **res}


def _ml_rank(eligible: list[dict]) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:
    """ML predictions for the eligible setups (shadow: recorded only; active: best probability first). Never adds or
    removes a setup; any ML failure leaves the rules' order untouched."""
    try:
        if ML.cfg()["mode"] == "off":
            return eligible, False
        out, info = ML.rank(eligible)
        return out, info["ranked"]
    except Exception as exc:                              # noqa: BLE001
        db.log("learning", f"ML ranking skipped: {str(exc)[:160]}", level="warn")
        return eligible, False


def _decision(symbol, tf, bar_time, s, stage, verdict, checks) -> int | None:
    try:
        return db.execute("INSERT INTO agent_decisions(t, symbol, tf, bar_time, strategy, direction, stage, verdict, setup, checks) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                          (db.now(), symbol, tf, bar_time, s["strategy"], s["direction"], stage, verdict,
                           json.dumps({k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != "_why"}, default=str), json.dumps(checks, default=str)))
    except Exception:                                     # noqa: BLE001 - UNIQUE: this exact setup was already decided
        return None


async def after_close(trade_ids: list[int]) -> None:
    for tid in trade_ids:
        try:
            L.review(tid)
            if CFG.agent().get("llm_reviews"):
                await L.llm_narrative(tid)
        except Exception as exc:                          # noqa: BLE001
            db.log("review", f"Review of #{tid} failed: {exc}", level="error")
    if trade_ids:
        for m in G.post_trade_limits():
